title: Wall-hook bracket load sweep
line: A static FEA study of an S355 steel wall-hook bracket under a 2 kN hanging load, checked against a 0.1 mm hook deflection limit and swept from 1 to 4 kN.
description: Static strength of a wall-hook bracket (40 x 50 x 35 mm, S355 steel, E = 210 GPa) on a linear tetrahedral mesh with a 6 mm target size. The base plate is bolted to a wall at its three countersunk mounting holes, which are held. A 2 kN load hangs from the hook: it presses down the wall (-Y) on the hook seat. The study checks the peak deflection of the hook seat against 0.1 mm, and the load sweep repeats the check from 1 to 4 kN in 0.5 kN steps. This is the study RunMat's guided setup wrote in the session shown on /simulation/structural.
thumbnailAlt: Displacement of an S355 steel wall-hook bracket under a 2 kN hanging load, solved in RunMat
